u0: No siren ring has yet been observed, so the conditional switch requirement is not active. Keep making progress toward the exit and watch for the siren; if it starts ringing, switch to the response subtask. This is also a terminal success state if the episode ends without the siren ever ringing, since no toggle was required.
u1: The siren has rung during the episode and the required switch response is still pending. The siren remains ringing until the switch is toggled, so the next objective is to reach the left-wall switch, face it, and toggle it successfully. This state is not terminal; a successful toggle gives reward and moves to the satisfied state.
u2: The wall switch has been toggled after a siren ring, so the required response has been completed. This is a terminal satisfied state: no further switch toggles are required, even if the siren rings again. Continue toward the exit or finish the episode without further obligation under this reward machine.
